apple.name: Pack One
apple.subtitle: Daily Limited Draft Challenge
apple.promotionalText: Three free Dailies every day. Make eight picks from real trophy drafts, then see what the drafter chose and how the model scored the alternatives.
apple.description:
Would you have made the same pick as a trophy drafter?

Pack One is a daily Magic: The Gathering Limited draft game. Each run has eight decisions from eight different trophy drafts. You'll see the pack and the cards the drafter had already picked. Make your choice, then see what they took.

Matching the trophy pick earns 100 points. Other picks can earn partial credit based on a model of real drafting behavior. The trophy drafter and the model don't always agree. Neither is right every time.

There are three free Dailies every day:
- Daily Draft Run
- Daily Powered Cube
- Daily Latest Set

Everyone plays the same decisions in each Daily, so you can compare scores on the leaderboards. You don't need an account to play.

A free Pack One account lets you join the leaderboards, save your results and play as many regular Draft Run practice games as you want. Elite adds Powered Cube and custom-set practice. Your account works on iPhone, iPad and packone.pro.
